title: Oozy Winey Grapes Pilaf
description: A dense and winey Australian dish perfect for a cozy date night, featuring nimono-simmered dates, cloves, and other lacto-vegetarian-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Arrange dates in a single layer on baking sheet. Drizzle with coconut oil and sprinkle with cloves. Bake for 20 minutes or until lightly browned.
Sauté onions and garlic in a pot over medium heat, adding more oil if needed.
Add diced tomatoes, white wine, and vegetable broth to the pot. Stir well.
Reduce mixture by half, then return baked dates and their juices to the pot. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Ladle mixture into a baking dish or shallow casserole. Place parchment paper on top if desired.
Bake in preheated oven for 25-30 minutes until pilaf is set and slightly golden on top.
